snippet.title: Five Nights at Candy's 4 (Fan-Concept) - Official Trailer | FANGAME DIRECT 3
snippet.description:
Five Nights at Candy’s 4 (Fan-Concept) is a fan-concept that envisions what the 4th installment in the Five Nights at Candy’s series could be like, while being the most accurate version of the real game thus far. The intention of this game isn’t to replace the original game, or drive away sales from the eventual release of the game as a paid product in the future, but the intention is to give FNaC and FNaF fans an experience to further hype up the future release of the real 4th installment in the Five Nights at Candy’s series.

Five Nights at Candy’s 4 (Fan-Concept) is being created by long-time fans of the FNaC series. Meaning, every corner of the game is getting as much love, care, attention and polish as Emil would add/care about. This game will be sure to give both FNaF and FNaC fans an experience that feels fulfilling and not half baked.
